scope: Read-only inspection of relative attention and append-only chunk loading source; runtime verification remains separate.
findings: Stored keys are raw pre-RoPE projections. Queries remain raw. Relative key rotation uses age0..63 and signed truncating division before the dot product.
The loader walks backward only until its64-position suffix is complete, authenticates every loaded code hash and enforces consecutive uint64 chunk headers.
Position-base arithmetic is separate from table indexing; table indices derive from relative age.
Processed/generated counters and encoded chunk starts use uint64. Checked arithmetic reverts on overflow; this is finite lifetime rather than an unbounded integer counter.
Native EOS ends a chunk but does not delete cached context or insert a new prompt.
